errors.description: Only the wearer's left lapel is in frame. The drawing shows both lapels, which is what proves the right lapel carries NO buttonhole; the tight crop demanded by the CLOSE CROP directive removes that side, so the 'left only' half of the option is implied rather than demonstrated.
errors.expected: both lapels visible so the empty right lapel can be compared against the doubled left lapel
errors.actual: a tight crop on the wearer's left lapel alone; the right lapel is outside the frame
errors.correction: if ever re-shot, pull back slightly to a chest-up frame that still keeps the two buttonholes at 40%+ of the frame but lets the plain right lapel enter at the frame edge

lockedFeatures: orientation: front of the jacket, chest area, model facing camera - CORRECT
EXACTLY TWO buttonholes, stacked one directly above the other, on a single lapel - CORRECT (counted: 2)
the buttonholes are on the WEARER'S LEFT lapel - CORRECT (the shirt collar and centre front sit to the frame-left of this lapel, which places it on the wearer's left)
the opposite (wearer's right) lapel carries no buttonhole - NOT VERIFIABLE, that lapel is outside the crop
notch lapel with the gorge/notch visible at the top of the lapel, matching the drawn collar-to-lapel junction - CORRECT
buttonholes worked horizontally, parallel to each other, sited on the outer half of the lapel below the notch - CORRECT
buttonholes worked in self-colour navy silk, hand-finished, no contrast thread - CORRECT
textured navy wool hopsack with visible weave, pressed lapel roll, pick-stitched lapel edge - CORRECT
seamless neutral light-grey studio background, no props, no environment - CORRECT

zero text, numbers, arrows, leader lines, red guide marks or callouts anywhere in frame - CORRECT (the red marks in the drawing were correctly read as highlights and rendered as navy buttonholes, not red)
notes: Attempt 1. The distinguishing detail - two stacked lapel buttonholes on the wearer's left lapel - is unambiguous and reads in well under a second. Buttonhole count verified by explicit count: two, no more. Side verified by the position of the shirt collar and centre front relative to the lapel. Fabric, lighting, background and cleanliness are all correct, and no annotation from the drawing was traced into the photograph. Sole finding is the compositional one above: the CLOSE CROP directive (which is mandatory in this pipeline) crops the right lapel out, so a customer sees the doubled left lapel but cannot directly compare it with the untouched right lapel. Logged as minor because the option's own construction is fully and correctly shown.
